Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the 1989 early/handmade release of Icehouse pieces with the later boxed product “Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set,” which BoardGameGeek shows as 1999. This misinterpretation of edition versus origin/commercial release led to repeatedly citing “The Martian Chess Set (1989)” despite BGG indicating 1999, reflecting a failure to distinguish between invention/test runs and the first boxed edition.
